method: Author read-only source/key/report/verdict adjudication; no model rerun, not independent fresh-context validation.

unsupported_gap_claims: dxt_version 0.1 is "an old format" is asserted with no source. The manifest version in use is the one the research packet references.

false_assurance_claims: "The endpoint is a fixed HTTPS URL (`bin/adapter.mjs:4`), so the bearer token can't be redirected to another host through configuration." This overstates. The unseen runtime's redirect and header-forwarding behavior is unknown. The research packet includes a redirect-header advisory that should have been checked against the runtime.

The headline "no significant security issues in the code I could see" and the heading "Credential handling (looks fine)" read as assurance. The report itself says it didn't see the runtime or the host storage.
"The token isn't logged or written to disk in this code" is true of the adapter only. It is presented alongside conclusions about the whole credential path.

reason: Remove the citation-only old-format allegation and optional-field omissions as independent unsupported security groups; source-authority checks retain missing reference evidence. No significant security issues in the code I could see is bounded discovery, not deployment approval. These do not warrant the three raw false-assurance penalties.
